A1.justification: Both PDFs describe Delta-XAI and SWING. Their main text, equations, tables, figures and complete appendices are readable and support comparison, including relocated material.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark comparisons, ablations, sensitivity analyses, computational measurements and clinical attribution case studies.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, revises some reported values and adds clinical attribution decompositions in Figure 11.

M1.justification: Algorithm 1 changes the integration segment index from floor(alpha*M) to min(floor(alpha*M), M-1), modifying endpoint handling. The wrapper and SWING components remain. The expanded baseline-distance description documents offsets already evaluated in v1 Table 3.

E1.justification: Both evaluate MIMIC-III, PhysioNet 2019, Activity, Delayed Spike and Switch-Feature on the same tasks. Figure 11 adds examples within the existing clinical task, without introducing a new population or test scenario.

E2.justification: The same 14 main baselines and corresponding supplementary comparator subsets remain. The revised FIT description clarifies its adaptation without establishing a changed comparator implementation.

E3.justification: Section 5.2 revises the stated removal domain from features at the final step T to all (T2-T1+W)*D entries across the combined window. This is a reported protocol revision; the PDFs do not establish rerunning. K=50, forward-fill substitution and the default time interval remain.

E4.justification: New Figure 11 adds four clinical contribution decompositions separating newly observed features, delayed effects and removed features. Existing ablation and robustness questions remain; new Appendix H explains previously reported ablations rather than introducing additional configurations.

E5.justification: Both report means and standard errors over five runs in Section 6.1. No new seed counts, confidence intervals or significance procedures appear. Revised error values in Table 3 do not change the reporting practice.

E6.justification: Table 3 revises eight metrics for 'w/o RBS', including CPD 40.55±0.27 to 40.25±0.22 and AUPD 24.54±0.19 to 24.39±0.12. Figure 4 replaces SWING/IG AUPD values near 32.6/26.2 with 16.2/9.1 without explaining the change, while retaining the stable trend. Figure 11 adds attribution results; the other benchmark tables retain their values.

T1.justification: Appendix F.2 corrects the baseline terms for paths gamma_2,2 and gamma_2,1 from T1-1 to T2-1. However, v2 Equation 9 changes subtraction to addition in SWING's aggregation, conflicting with the subtraction retained in Algorithm 1 and Equation 23. The theorem statements remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions: adapting 14 explainers, evaluating prediction-change explanations, establishing competitive classical gradient methods and introducing SWING. Added evidence does not materially broaden these claims.

C2.justification: Section 6.4 extends clinical interpretations to the new Figure 11 examples, including increased risk with oxygen desaturation and reduced risk with improved GCS. Existing mechanism explanations and Appendix A limitations remain substantially unchanged.

D1.justification: New Appendix H specifies the zero-baseline substitutions and retained integration paths for existing ablations. Section D.2 clarifies FIT's class-specific computations. The reported code location changes from an anonymous repository to the named AITRICS GitHub repository; its availability was not externally checked.

R1.justification: v2 adds Marincowitz et al. (2018) to support the GCS interpretation. Most other reference edits update publication metadata or remove a duplicate PhysioNet entry; the substantive positioning against previous XAI methods remains.

P1.justification: v2 expands the historical-integration explanation, rewrites FIT documentation, introduces research-question bullets and adds an ablation-details appendix and acknowledgements. Author and conference-header details also change. The overall narrative and section sequence remain largely intact.

P2.justification: v2 adds Figure 11's four waterfall plots, redraws Figure 4 with a different vertical scale and explicit legend, and adjusts Figure 1's presentation and caption. Equations receive numbers and appendix tables move between pages; existing tables and attribution heatmaps are retained.

improvement.justification: Added ablation documentation, corrected proof indices and clearer clinical decompositions improve exposition. However, the revised central SWING equation conflicts with the retained algorithm and proof, and Figure 4's substantial numerical replacement is unexplained. These competing changes prevent a reliable net quality judgment.
